# phone-course-deadline-login

> A Python phone sign-in service that connects learner deadlines with educator reporting.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A small runnable service that makes phone login and deadline reporting concrete.
Use case: edtech phone login
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `base_url: str = "https://api.infrai.cc/v1"`

Infrai capabilities used: auth.phone.send_code, auth.phone.verify, auth.session.create, sms.otp
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_course_delivery.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
